OBJECTS_AT_PRESCRIBED_POSITIONS.rule: Several specified objects occupy their own stated positions respectively.

SPECIFIED_SET_IN_POSITION_SET.rule: A specified set fills a stated set of positions in any internal order.

AT_MOST_GAP_BETWEEN_PAIR.rule: The number of other objects between two specified objects ranges from zero through the stated maximum.

DIRECTIONAL_EXACT_GAP.rule: The first named object appears before the second with exactly the stated number of intervening objects.

AT_LEAST_SPECIFIED_IN_POSITION_CLASS.rule: At least the stated number of specified objects occupies the eligible odd/even position class.
